justification: A shows dense vertical columns of square glyph-like blocks covering the whole shaft, while B shows schematic profile boats with upturned prows and rows of crew-strokes plus a horned/rayed figure; the only shared feature is the generic use of repeated small units in rows and some rectangular compartments.
